children.title: Level-wise half purity (Theorem D) is reconstructible
children.statement_en: Every graph G on at least 3 vertices with a vertex u such that, for every j, either every neighbour y of u of degree j + 1 is forced, or every non-neighbour y ≠ u of degree j is forced, is reconstructible. Here y is forced if every ordered pair (x', y') with x' ≠ y', deg x' = deg u and G − x' − y' ≅ G − u − y has the adjacency of (u, y) (Theorem D of debe_codegree.md; contains the pure degree class).

children.title: Narrow two-card-types class is reconstructible
children.statement_en: Every graph G on at least 3 vertices whose degrees are all d or d + 1, whose cards at vertices of equal degree are isomorphic, and which has a card isomorphism α : G − u ≅ G − u' and a neighbour x of u with α(x) not adjacent to u' (so α does not extend to an automorphism), is reconstructible (narrow two-card-types class, Zinchenko arXiv:2611.13728 §§2–4; debe_zinchenko.md §6 N).
children.statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => (∃ d : ℕ, ∀ x : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = d ∨ (G.neighborSet x).ncard = d + 1) ∧ (∀ x y : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = (G.neighborSet y).ncard → Nonempty (G.induce ({x}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)))) ∧ ∃ u u' : Fin n, ∃ α : G.induce ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∃ x : ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), G.Adj u x.1 ∧ ¬ G.Adj u' (α x).1)

children.title: Residual: dominating-edge residual without level-wise half purity and outside the narrow two-card class
children.statement_en: Every graph in the dominating-edge residual (as in conj_kelly_ulam__connected_dominating_or_diam2__dominating_edge_impure) that has no level-wise half-pure vertex (as in level_half_pure) and is not in the narrow two-card class (as in two_card_narrow) is reconstructible. Open.
